content.text:
The font was failing to load, so every page fell back to the system font.

**Cause:** `site/css/tokens.css` pointed the `@font-face` at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the directory is `site/fonts/`. The font file 404'd, and text on every page changed typeface and metrics. That is why the whole site looked different.

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`. This is a one-line change.

**Verification:**
- All 12 visual tests now pass, for 6 pages at desktop and phone size.
- All 16 functional tests pass.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't see which change introduced the typo. I found the cause by reading the CSS and checking the paths. I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE
